title: Pure Destiny HERO
summary: The page's Destiny-focused build: its recommended copies of the Beyond the Brave cards, the classic Destiny HERO core, Polymerization and generic staples. The Vision, Elemental, Masked and Xtra HERO engines of the Omni-HERO build are left out. Doom Overlord, the one-card starter, mills Malicious and adds Dark City at Midnight; the city searches Dreadnought Servant, which destroys the city to summon Dreadmaster from the Deck. Tributing Dreadmaster brings out Dreadnought Master, which searches two more cards. Doom Overlord and Fusion Destiny lock you into DARK HERO monsters for the turn.
main: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord
Newest support. Summoned: banishes a monster until the next Standby Phase; mills a Destiny HERO to add Dark City at Midnight or Clock Tower Prison.
Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant
Newest support. Summons itself next to a Destiny HERO or Field Spell, destroys your city and adds Polymerization.
Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma
Newest support. Banishes three Warrior or DARK monsters to summon itself; Fusion Summons on their turn.
Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster
Summoned by the city or Clock Tower Prison: revives two Destiny HEROes; Tribute it for Dreadnought Master.
Destiny HERO - Malicious
Banishes itself from the GY to summon the other copy from the Deck.
Destiny HERO - Drilldark
Summoned: summons a Destiny HERO from the hand.
Destiny HERO - Denier
Summoned: puts a Destiny HERO on top of the Deck; revives itself once.
Destiny HERO - Decider
Summoned: returns a HERO from the GY at the End Phase.
Destiny HERO - Disk Commander
Revived from the GY: draws two.
Destiny HERO - Plasma
Tributes three to negate every opposing monster and absorb one.
Dark City at Midnight
Newest support. Field Spell: searches a Destiny HERO card; destroyed, summons a Destiny HERO from the Deck.
Clock Tower Prison
The other Field Spell Doom Overlord fetches; Dreadmaster's classic summon.
Polymerization
Dreadnought Servant searches it for the Destiny Fusions.
Fusion Destiny
Fusion Summons a Destiny HERO Fusion from the hand or Deck.
Destiny Draw
Discards a Destiny HERO to draw two.
D - Tactics
Banishes a card when a Level 8+ Destiny HERO arrives; destroyed, searches one.
D-Fusion
Quick Fusion Summon from your Destiny HEROes, protected that turn.
